M4 baseline — live Supabase (tarmpqxsabbehgjaonfz), 27 Aug 2026, BEFORE apply

V0 · tuesday_review_pack() — THE FUNCTION M4 REPLACES
  HEADER  as_of=2026-08-27  meeting_id=(none)  previous=(none)
          completion_rate=null  unassigned open_now=0  last_week=0
  ORG     BOPEU     open_count=0  needs_decision=false  last_week=0  open_now=0  billing=ABSENT
  ORG     Sedimosa  open_count=0  needs_decision=false  last_week=0  open_now=0  billing=ABSENT
  (Test Co is correctly absent — it is flagged is_test.)

COUNTS THAT MUST NOT MOVE
  program_activities rows   1
  bookings rows             22
  organizations rows        3
  actions rows              0
  meetings rows             0

MUST NOT CHANGE
  activity_type constraint  CHECK (activity_type = ANY (ARRAY['group_intervention',
                            'education_talk','webinar','clinic','other']))
  threshold_config invoice.*   (none)
  tuesday_review_pack calls _billing_flags   no


THE PREDICTION — written before applying. See the migration header.

  CHANGES
    Five new tables appear, ALL EMPTY: org_contracts, contract_rates,
    org_contacts, work_plans, billing_handovers.
    program_activities gains twelve columns; bookings gains one. NO ROW in
    either is added, removed or altered.
    Fourteen functions appear.
    threshold_config gains invoice.prepared_by_user_id (null = the first ops
    admin, which is Lone) and invoice.prepare_day (25). It does NOT gain
    invoice.due_days -- the migration deletes that key, because the handover
    carries no date of its own.
    A daily job kw-monthly-handovers appears at 0 3 * * *.

  ONE EXISTING FUNCTION IS REPLACED
    tuesday_review_pack(). Every organisation gains a `billing` key, which
    will read [] because there are no contracts and therefore no handovers.
    needs_decision may turn true where a retainer period is past its prepare
    day without Lone's confirmation -- there are none today, so it stays false.
    EVERY OTHER KEY MUST BE IDENTICAL: as_of, meeting_id, previous_meeting_id,
    completion_rate, last_week, open_now, open_count, unassigned.

  DOES NOT CHANGE
    No booking, no member, no report. The five counts above are unchanged.
    The activity_type constraint is untouched -- it is a reporting input, and
    if it moves, org_report_data() has moved with it.
    No published report can move: publish_org_report() froze those into
    org_reports.data_snapshot and HR reads the snapshot.
    Nobody gains sight of anything: every policy is staff-read, ops-admin-write.
    HR and members get no policy at all.

  IF IT IS WRONG
    The realistic failure is the Tuesday review showing a wrong flag or failing
    to load. No data is damaged, because nothing existing is written to.
    Undo with migrations/rollback-m4-contracts-workplans-billing.sql, which
    drops what it created AND restores tuesday_review_pack() to its M5 body,
    refusing to finish if the restored function still calls _billing_flags.

  EXPECTED AFTER-STATE, EXACTLY
    ORG BOPEU     ... billing=[]
    ORG Sedimosa  ... billing=[]
    everything else on those two lines and the HEADER line unchanged.
